skill_name: Write an explanation of why wearing a helmet is important
workflow: Wearing a helmet is an important safety measure for bike riders and should always be done whenever you are on your bike. Bike helmets are designed to help protect your head from serious injuries in the event of an accident or fall. The helmet absorbs and disperses impact energy, which prevents it from being transferred to the head and brain.
